SD70-012.name: Agi
SD70-012.effect:
While your "Persona" family Spirit is attacking, this card in Hand becomes Cost 0.

[Flash]
Ignoring the Cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate. Or, if you have five counters or more, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost.

SD70-008.name: Hermes
SD70-008.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Magician Arcana, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Once per turn, your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Discard a card from the opposing decktop, and for each symbol on the discarded cards combined, destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

SD70-004.name: Io
SD70-004.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Lovers Arcana, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, refresh a Spirit you control.

SD70-005.name: Isis
SD70-005.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Lovers Arcana & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Refresh two other Spirits you control. Also, if this Spirit [Contract Advents], you can immediately end the battle.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.

SD70-001.name: Orpheus
SD70-001.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Wild, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

SD70-009.name: Trismegistus
SD70-009.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Magician Arcana & C4 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Destroy an opposing Cost 9 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit gains +10000 BP. Also, while you have five counters or more, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

SD70-X01.name: ［Death］ Thanatos
SD70-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Wild & C5 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can send core from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve until one core remains on each of them. Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Protagonist", this effect is treated as colorless.

[During Advent] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with one core or less on it, and when destroys, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

SD70-006.name: ［Gekkoukan High School Uniform］ Iori Junpei
SD70-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "S.E.E.S."/"Persona" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3]
All your "Persona" family Spirits are treated as being one LV higher.

SD70-002.name: ［Gekkoukan High School Uniform］ Takeba Yukari
SD70-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add to the Hand a "S.E.E.S."/"Persona" family card with a card name different to this Spirit's. Discard any remaining cards.

SD70-010.name: ［Gekkoukan High School Uniform］ Yamagishi Fuuka
SD70-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your other "Gekkoukan High School Uniform" is summoned/deployed, you can put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your "S.E.E.S." family Spirit attacks, your counter +1.

SD70-007.name: ［S.E.E.S. Official Battle Uniform］ Iori Junpei
SD70-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can return a Cost 4 or more "Magician Arcana" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When you would [Contract Advent] "Hermes"/"Trismegistus" onto this Spirit, you can [Contract Advent] it, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

SD70-003.name: ［S.E.E.S. Official Battle Uniform］ Takeba Yukari
SD70-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Persona" family "Io"/"Isis" to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. Then, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "S.E.E.S." family Contract Spirit, your counter +1.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When you would [Contract Advent] "Io"/"Isis" onto this Spirit, you can [Contract Advent] it, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

SD70-011.name: ［S.E.E.S. Official Battle Uniform］ Yamagishi Fuuka
SD70-011.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Blue Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
All your attacking "S.E.E.S."/"Persona" family Spirits can't be blocked by opposing Spirits/Ultimates with a cost different to that target's.

[LV1] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your "S.E.E.S." family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

SD70-CX01.name: ［S.E.E.S. Official Battle Uniform］ Protagonist
SD70-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Soul State][Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your other "S.E.E.S."/"Persona" family card is summoned/deployed/[Contract Advents], or when this Spirit attacks, your counters +2, and draw two cards, then discard two cards from your Hand.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, when opposing Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, you can refresh this Spirit.
